title: OpenAI begins rolling out ChatGPT for Teens
reason: PUBLISHED (cycle 1). OpenAI began rolling out ChatGPT for Teens on 18 August 2026 -- a 13-17 age-gated version with content restrictions (self-harm, eating disorders, violence, romantic/sexual content), an AI-consciousness-claim ban, teen-specific learning tools, and parental controls (Quiet Hours, Study Hours, flagged-risk notifications only, no direct conversation access). Verified via our own registered OpenAI News RSS ingest (Tier 0, confirms the item and its 2026-08-18T11:00:00Z pubDate) plus a fresh verifier sub-agent (Euronews/Fortune/AP direct fetches; openai.com itself 403'd to WebFetch, a known blocker) and a fresh adversarial falsifier sub-agent (separate context; confirmed this is a genuine same-day launch via ~15 convergent independent outlets, not a re-announcement or mis-dated leak). Falsifier raised and we incorporated: the rollout is phased (~2 weeks to complete globally, Australia by 8 September) rather than instantly complete, and the launch carries real critical-reception context (TechCrunch questions control durability against determined teens; child-safety-advocate skepticism reported; lands amid the Raine v. OpenAI wrongful-death suit, which OpenAI disputes, and California's SB 243). dedup-check returned only moderate/coincidental matches (score 0.5, no shared URLs) against unrelated OpenAI/ChatGPT stories -- read and confirmed none concern teen safety, age prediction, or parental controls.
watch: Whether the phased rollout completes on OpenAI's stated ~2-week timeline, or slips
